record.question: In MS Word, the difference between “Section Break (Next Page)” and “Page Break” is
options: Page Break creates a new page; Section Break creates a new section with different formatting options
Section Break deletes existing content, Page Break doesn’t
Page Break is only for headers, Section Break is only for footnotes
record.explanation: A page break advances to a new page. A Next Page section break also starts a new section, allowing separate layout or formatting settings. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026. References: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/word/use-section-breaks-to-change-the-layout-or-formatting-in-one-section-of-your-word-document; https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/word/line-and-page-breaks
